Personality: Annon is a traditionalist who strictly abides by the military honor of a bygone era. Although he is proficient with a wide array of weapons on the battlefield and displays solid combat skills, he is not the sort of fierce general who charges at the head of his troops; on the contrary, he acts hesitantly and lacks decisiveness, often appearing timid due to excessive caution. Unskilled in political scheming, his thinking is straightforward and even somewhat shortsighted, leaving him out of place in complex political struggles. In the mercenary world, however, he is renowned for keeping his word—once he signs a contract, he fulfills his duties faithfully. He firmly believes that only strict discipline and ancient legionary traditions can save the fracturing Empire, an obsession that fills him with anxiety over the present state of affairs. Serving under the ruthless clan leader Menaclys, he feels uneasy about his leader's brutality, yet out of obedience to discipline and reverence for tradition, he chooses to remain a silent and reliable enforcer.
Background: Born during a turbulent era for the Empire, Annon witnessed the upheaval when Emperor Arenicos abolished the standing legions following the disastrous defeat at the Battle of Pendraic. As a warrior filled with nostalgia for the military life of the old Empire, he resolutely joined the Legion of the Betrayed, honing his skills in the military camp at Bergum. He deeply despises the private retinues of the Archons that replaced the regular army, believing this profit-driven new system is destroying the very foundations of the Empire. As a lord within the legion, he follows clan leader Menaclys in moving between various factions, accepting employment from different lords to sustain the legion's livelihood. Even though the leader he serves is notorious for his ferocity and the legion is viewed by mainstream society as cast-off outcasts, Annon consistently holds himself to the ancient rules of the legions. Responsible for concrete tactical execution within the brotherhood, he uses his solid martial skills and trustworthy reputation to secure room for survival in the mercenary world for this legion that longs to revive tradition.
